blocks.source: 【コラム】市販ＲＰＧのクリア率
blocks.translation: [Column] Commercial RPG Completion Rates

blocks.source: 皆さんはどれぐらいのプレイヤーがＲＰＧをクリアしているか、ご存じでしょうか？
blocks.translation: Do you know what percentage of players complete RPGs?

blocks.source: アマチュアＲＰＧ作家としては気になるところですが、今までは調べようがありませんでした。……が、実はＰＳ３以降の市販ゲームに限り、それを確認する方法があったりします。
blocks.translation: This is something I’ve been curious about as an amateur RPG creator, but until now there was no way to find out. …Or so I thought—actually, there is a way to check, but only for commercially released games from the PS3 onward.

blocks.source: どうするかといえば、トロフィー機能を参照するだけです。
blocks.translation: All you have to do is check the trophy feature.

blocks.source: ※ＰＳ３以降を持ってない方のために説明すると、トロフィーというのは各ゲームで達成した出来事を記録するための機能です。「とあるボスを倒した」「レアアイテムを手に入れた」「とあるイベントをクリアした」などといったものがあります。
blocks.translation: ※For those who don’t own a PS3 or later, trophies are a feature that records achievements in each game. These include things like “defeated a certain boss,” “obtained a rare item,” and “completed a certain event.”

blocks.source: ＰＳ４（Ｖｉｔａも？）ではネット接続しているプレイヤーを対象に、各トロフィー毎の達成率が表示されるようになっています。
blocks.translation: On the PS4 (and Vita, perhaps?), the completion rate for each trophy is displayed for players connected to the internet.

blocks.source: 大抵のゲームにはクリアによるトロフィーが存在しているので、クリア率も確認可能――というわけです。
blocks.translation: Since most games have a trophy for completing them, that means you can also check their completion rates.

blocks.source: ※細かいことを言うと、ＰＳ３には達成率の表示はありませんが、ＰＳ４からＰＳ３のゲームも確認できます。
blocks.translation: ※Strictly speaking, the PS3 does not display completion rates, but you can check PS3 games from a PS4.

blocks.source: そんなわけで興味本位を発揮して、自分が持っているタイトルを確認してみました。ＰＳ３以降のゲームはさほどやれてないので、サンプル数がやや少なめです。
blocks.translation: So, driven by curiosity, I checked the titles I own. I haven’t played that many games from the PS3 onward, so the sample size is somewhat small.

blocks.source: ※注意書き
blocks.translation: ※Notes

blocks.source: 2017/1/12調べ。ＦＦ１５は発売間もないので、まだ多少は上がるかも。
blocks.translation: Checked on 2017/1/12. Final Fantasy XV had only recently been released, so its rate may still rise somewhat.

blocks.source: クリア時間はあくまで筆者による参考値です。
blocks.translation: The completion times are merely reference values based on the author’s experience.

blocks.source: 自分でクリアしてないものは？をつけています。
blocks.translation: A question mark indicates games I did not complete myself.

blocks.source: 本編とは別に後日談的なものがある場合は（）で追記しています。
blocks.translation: If there is an epilogue-like story separate from the main game, it is noted in parentheses.

blocks.source: ＰＳ＋のフリープレイ対象である場合は、率が下がると考えられます。「無料なのでインストールしたけど、すぐ止めた」というパターンがあるので。
blocks.translation: Games included in PS Plus’s free game lineup can be expected to have lower rates, since some people install them because they’re free but stop playing soon afterward.

blocks.source: この中では、閃の軌跡１～２やデモンズソウルがそれに該当。
blocks.translation: Among these, Trails of Cold Steel I–II and Demon’s Souls fall into that category.

blocks.source: さて、どうでしょうか？ 個人的には驚くほど低いですね。
blocks.translation: So, what do you think? Personally, I find them surprisingly low.

blocks.source: 見る限り、プレイヤーの半分程度クリアしていればマシなほうです。
blocks.translation: Judging by these figures, having about half of the players complete a game is actually relatively good.

blocks.source: 自分の場合、お金を出して買ったゲームの九割はクリアするようにしています。そのため、他のプレイヤーについても、標準的なＲＰＧならば、八割ぐらいはクリアするだろう――と勝手に想像していました。
blocks.translation: Personally, I make a point of completing nine out of every ten games I pay for. Because of that, I had assumed—quite arbitrarily—that around 80% of other players would complete a standard RPG as well.

blocks.source: 今の時代、ネット上で簡単に攻略が見れますので、クリアできないゲームというのはさほど多くないはず――という見立てもありました。
blocks.translation: I also thought that, in this day and age, there shouldn’t be that many games people can’t complete, since walkthroughs are readily available online.

blocks.source: それでもご覧の有様。
blocks.translation: And yet, these are the results.

blocks.source: またこれは、ゲーム機一台辺りに対する判定であることも注意してください。実際には、家族で一台を共有しているようなパターンが大半でしょう。
blocks.translation: Also keep in mind that these figures are measured per game console. In reality, the most common situation is probably a family sharing a single console.

blocks.source: 「兄ちゃんはクリアしたけど、弟は飽きてやめた」などのパターンであっても、トロフィーは達成とカウントされます。
blocks.translation: Even in cases like “Big brother completed it, but little brother got bored and quit,” the trophy is still counted as achieved.

blocks.source: 一人当たりのクリア率は、もう少し低いと考えたほうがよいかもしれません。
blocks.translation: It may be better to assume that the completion rate per person is somewhat lower.

blocks.source: 低すぎるＦＦ１３のクリア率
blocks.translation: Final Fantasy XIII’s Far Too Low Completion Rate

blocks.source: 個別の例に言及すると、目に見えて低いＦＦ１３（27.7%）が際立ちます。
blocks.translation: Looking at individual examples, the conspicuously low rate for Final Fantasy XIII (27.7%) stands out.

blocks.source: クリアしたプレイヤーは全体の三割にも満たないのが現実。他のＲＰＧと比較して、半分近いクリア率と表現してよいでしょう。
blocks.translation: In reality, fewer than 30% of all players completed it. Compared with other RPGs, it would be fair to describe its completion rate as nearly half as high.

blocks.source: ストーリー的な評判があまりよくないのは周知の通りですし、難易度も高めです。ただプレイ時間（筆者で４０時間）がさほど長くないので、そこまでクリア難度が高いという印象はありません。
blocks.translation: As is well known, its story has a rather poor reputation, and the difficulty is also on the high side. However, since the playtime (40 hours in my case) isn’t particularly long, I don’t get the impression that it is exceptionally difficult to complete.

blocks.source: なんだかんだで「手応えがあって面白い」と楽しんでいる声も聞こえたため、ここまでの実態は予想外でした。
blocks.translation: Despite everything, I heard some people saying they were enjoying it because it was "challenging and fun," so the reality turned out to be unexpected.

blocks.source: そんなわけで、投げ出されやすい理由を考えてみます。
blocks.translation: With that in mind, let me consider why people are so likely to give up on it.

blocks.source: 基本的な難易度が高い。
blocks.translation: The basic difficulty is high.

blocks.source: ※後日、イージーモードが搭載されたようだが、時既に遅し。
blocks.translation: ※An Easy Mode appears to have been added later, but by then it was too late.

blocks.source: 後半、自由度が急激に上がる。それ自体は長所とも言えるが、サブイベントをこなしているうちに飽きる場合も。
blocks.translation: The degree of freedom rises sharply in the latter half. That can be considered a strength in itself, but some players may get bored while completing the side events.

blocks.source: ゲーム進行によって成長の上限がある。
blocks.translation: The growth cap depends on game progression.

blocks.source: レベルを上げてのゴリ押しが難しい。
blocks.translation: It is difficult to brute-force your way through by leveling up.

blocks.source: 敵がしぶとく、回復が容易でなかなか全滅しない。
blocks.translation: The enemies are tenacious, and healing is easy, so it is difficult to wipe them out.

blocks.source: 結果、戦闘が長ったるく長時間戦ってからの全滅がプレイヤーの心を折る。
blocks.translation: As a result, the long, drawn-out battles and being wiped out after fighting for a long time break the player's spirit.

blocks.source: 売上が多いためユーザ層が広い。相対的にライトユーザの比率が高い。
blocks.translation: Because it sold so well, its user base is broad. Relatively speaking, it has a high proportion of casual users.

blocks.source: こんなところでしょうか。
blocks.translation: That about covers it, I suppose.

blocks.source: 特に３，４はこのゲーム特有の要素なので、影響が大きかったのではないかと思います。
blocks.translation: In particular, points 3 and 4 are elements unique to this game, so I think they may have had a significant impact.

blocks.source: 察するに、ＦＦ１３という作品は想像以上に敷居が高く、マニアックなゲームになっていたのではないでしょうか。
blocks.translation: It seems to me that FF XIII was more intimidating and had become more of a niche game than one might have imagined.

blocks.source: http://www.psmk2.net/index.php?r=site/title&title_id=519&db=1
blocks.translation: http://www.psmk2.net/index.php?r=site/title&title_id=519&db=1

blocks.source: 事実、レビューサイトの点数分布が特徴的で、高得点から低得点へ満遍なく広がっています。これは人を選ぶゲームに見られる特徴です。
blocks.translation: In fact, the distribution of scores on review sites is distinctive, spreading evenly from high scores to low scores. This is characteristic of games that appeal only to certain people.

blocks.source: 多くのユーザはゲームをクリアして批判するような段階にも至らず、『このゲームは難しい』『雰囲気が合わない』『つまらない』などといって去っていったのではないかと。
blocks.translation: Many users probably never even reached the point of clearing the game and criticizing it; they simply left, saying things like, "This game is too difficult," "The atmosphere doesn't suit me," or "It's boring."

blocks.source: さすがに「クリア困難なゲーム＝悪いゲーム」と決めつけるのは短絡的かと思います。デモンズソウルのようなヘビーユーザ向けなら、そうでなくては面白くないというファンも多いでしょう。
blocks.translation: Surely, deciding that "a game that is difficult to clear equals a bad game" is overly simplistic. For a game aimed at hardcore users, like Demon's Souls, many fans would probably say it would not be fun otherwise.

blocks.source: ただ、ミリオン級の大衆向けＲＰＧとしては致命的です。プレイヤーの七割が放り出すゲームが、売上百万を維持できるかというとそりゃ無理です。
blocks.translation: However, it is fatal for a mainstream RPG aimed at million-selling numbers. If a game is abandoned by seventy percent of its players, there is no way it can maintain sales of a million copies.

blocks.source: 特にＦＦのようなストーリーが重視される作品ではなおさらです。なんせ、最後までやらなければ真に堪能できたとは言い難いですから。
blocks.translation: This is especially true for works like FF, where the story is a major focus. After all, if you do not play to the end, it is difficult to say that you truly experienced it.

blocks.source: そして、堪能できなかった作品の次回作を買う動機は薄いです。ＦＦ１３→ＦＦ１３－２のように物語の繋がった続編なら、前作をクリアしなければ意味不明になります。
blocks.translation: And there is little motivation to buy the next installment of a game you could not fully enjoy. With a story-connected sequel like FF XIII → FF XIII-2, the sequel becomes incomprehensible if you have not cleared the previous game.

blocks.source: 売上データ
blocks.translation: Sales Data

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３ ：初週１５１万 累計１９３万
blocks.translation: FF XIII: 1.51 million in its first week, 1.93 million cumulative

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３－２： 累計８４万
blocks.translation: FF XIII-2: 840,000 cumulative

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３ＬＲ： 累計２８万
blocks.translation: FF XIII LR: 280,000 cumulative

blocks.source: ＦＦ１５ ：初週６９万 累計１００万？（未確定）
blocks.translation: FF XV: 690,000 in its first week, 1 million cumulative? (unconfirmed)

blocks.source: ※ＦＦ１４はネトゲで性質が違うため省きます。
blocks.translation: ※FF XIV is omitted because it is an online game with different characteristics.

blocks.source: 続編のものとして参考
blocks.translation: For Reference: Sequels

blocks.source: ＦＦ１０ ：累計２５０万
blocks.translation: FF X: 2.5 million cumulative
FF X-2: 2 million cumulative

blocks.source: こうしてみれば、ＦＦ１３－２およびＦＦ１５の売上激減も納得できようというものです。
blocks.translation: Seen in this light, the sharp drop in sales of FF XIII-2 and FF XV becomes understandable.

blocks.source: 一般的なＲＰＧの半分程度しかクリアされていないＦＦ１３の次回作。ゆえに、前作の半分しか売れなかった。ちょっと強引かもしれませんが、こういう見方もできるかなと。
blocks.translation: FF XIII's sequel was based on a game that only about half as many people cleared as a typical RPG. Consequently, it sold only half as many copies as its predecessor. This may be a somewhat forceful interpretation, but it is one possible way of looking at it.

blocks.source: というか、宣伝や話題性ではポケモンサンムーン（累計３００万超え）にも負けないレベルだったのに、売上は天と地の差です。本格的にユーザーから愛想を尽かされているのだな――と、かつてのＦＦ信者スクエニ信者としては悲しい気分です。
blocks.translation: Actually, although its advertising and buzz were on a level that could rival Pokémon Sun and Moon (over 3 million cumulative), the difference in sales is like night and day. As a former FF and Square Enix diehard, it makes me sad to think that users have truly lost interest in it.

blocks.source: 今のところ、ＦＦ１５のクリア率（38.2%）も厳しいところですね。ペルソナ５（47.9%）の数分の一の時間でクリアできることを考えると、やはり低いです。
blocks.translation: For now, FF XV's clear rate (38.2%) is also concerning. Considering that it can be cleared in a fraction of the time required for Persona 5 (47.9%), it is still low.

blocks.source: その他トロフィーを眺めて気づいた点
blocks.translation: Other Observations from Looking at the Trophies

blocks.source: クリア率は半分が標準
blocks.translation: A 50% Clear Rate Is Standard

blocks.source: クリア率が５０％程度あれば標準的。
blocks.translation: A clear rate of around 50% is considered standard.

blocks.source: プレイヤーの半分しかクリアしてないのでは、次回作で売上激減するんじゃ――と、心配になりそうですが、わりと大丈夫なようです。
blocks.translation: You might worry that if only half of the players cleared a game, sales of the next installment would plummet—but apparently, things are generally fine.

blocks.source: それだけあれば、次回作も同等程度の売上が見込める模様。もちろん、内容と評判がまともなことが前提です。
blocks.translation: With that many players, the next installment can apparently be expected to achieve roughly comparable sales. Of course, this assumes that its content and reputation are sound.

blocks.source: 上の表で言えば、テイルズオブグレイセスｆの本編クリア率（63.8%）が優秀ですが、次回作の売上にも結びついているようです。
blocks.translation: In the table above, Tales of Graces f has an excellent clear rate for its main story (63.8%), and this also seems to have translated into sales of the next installment.

blocks.source: テイルズオブグレイセス：初週３６万本 累計５５万本（ＰＳ３＋Ｗｉｉ）
blocks.translation: Tales of Graces: 360,000 copies in its first week, 550,000 cumulative (PS3 + Wii)

blocks.source: テイルズオブエクシリア：初週５２万本 累計６７万本（ＰＳ３のみ）
blocks.translation: Tales of Xillia: 520,000 copies in its first week, 670,000 cumulative (PS3 only)

blocks.source: エクシリア以降で評判と売上を落としたのが、つくづくもったいないですね。この調子ならＦＦ１５（初週６９万）の背中も見えていたのでは……。
blocks.translation: It is truly a shame that its reputation and sales declined after Xillia. At this rate, it might even have been within reach of FF XV's first-week sales (690,000)...

blocks.source: こうなると「難易度が低くクリア時間も短いが、つまらないＲＰＧ」だとクリア率や次回作売上がどうなるのか――とか、気になりますが、データがないので語りません。
blocks.translation: This makes me wonder what the clear rate and sales of the next installment would be for a "boring RPG with low difficulty and a short completion time," but I will not discuss it because there is no data.

blocks.source: 超序盤の脱落者
blocks.translation: Players Who Drop Out Very Early

blocks.source: 開始一時間など、超序盤での脱落者が５～１０％程度どのゲームにも存在する。
blocks.translation: Every game has about 5–10% of its players drop out very early, such as within the first hour.

blocks.source: 合わないと見て、速攻で中古に売り払っているとかでしょうか？
blocks.translation: Perhaps they decide it is not for them and immediately sell it to a used-game store?

blocks.source: 脱落率はプレイ時間に比例
blocks.translation: The Dropout Rate Is Proportional to Play Time

blocks.source: 多くのゲームでは、シナリオの区切りによってトロフィーを獲得できるようになっています。つまり、プレイヤーがどの段階でどの程度脱落したかも一目瞭然です。
blocks.translation: In many games, trophies can be earned at scenario milestones. In other words, it is immediately obvious at what stage, and to what extent, players dropped out.

blocks.source: 当然、難所になるほど達成率が下がるはず。……そう考えていたのですが、思ったほど差が出ませんでした。
blocks.translation: Naturally, the completion rate should fall as the difficulty increases. ...That is what I thought, but the difference was not as large as expected.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＦＦ１５の悪名高い十三章ですが、達成率の変化は47%→43%というように、精々が一割程度に過ぎません。
blocks.translation: For example, in the infamous Chapter 13 of FF XV, the change in completion rate was only about one-tenth at most, going from 47% to 43%.

blocks.source: 他の章と比較しても大差はありません。単純に時間のかかる章で、脱落者が多い傾向があったぐらいです。特に三章（83%→71%）のように、自由度が上がるタイミングでの脱落者が目立ちました。
blocks.translation: There is no significant difference compared with the other chapters. It merely showed a tendency for more players to drop out in chapters that took a long time. In particular, many players dropped out when the degree of freedom increased, as in Chapter 3 (83% → 71%).

blocks.source: まとめると……
blocks.translation: In summary...

blocks.source: プレイヤーの脱落は最初から最後までわりと満遍なく存在する。
blocks.translation: Players drop out fairly evenly from start to finish.

blocks.source: もう少し言うと、プレイ時間が伸びるごとに、脱落者が発生している。
blocks.translation: To put it another way, players drop out with each additional hour of playtime.

blocks.source: 評価が良いゲームであっても、１時間伸びるごとに１％ぐらいは脱落。
blocks.translation: Even for well-reviewed games, about 1% of players drop out with each additional hour.
At 25 hours, 77.78%
At 50 hours, 60.5%
At 75 hours, 47.06%
At 100 hours, 36.6%

blocks.source: クリア率の表とどことなく一致しています。
blocks.translation: This coincides, more or less, with the completion-rate table.

blocks.source: しかも、これは良作として評価される作品、および敷居の低い作品の場合です。
blocks.translation: What’s more, this applies to games considered good and games with a low barrier to entry.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３に至っては１時間ごとに３％前後脱落している計算になります。
blocks.translation: In the case of FF13, the calculation comes to around 3% dropping out every hour.

blocks.source: こうしてみると、プレイ時間稼ぎって本当に必要なのか疑問に感じます。
blocks.translation: Looking at it this way, I wonder whether padding the playtime is really necessary.

blocks.source: 「プレイ時間を稼いで、中古に売られないようにしている」なんて俗説を聞きますが、本当だとしたら危うい発想ですね。プレイヤーが投げ出して、次回作を買ってもらえなくなる危険のほうが大きいのではないでしょうか。
blocks.translation: I’ve heard the popular theory that games pad their playtime so players won’t sell them used, but if that’s true, it’s a dangerous way of thinking. Wouldn’t there be a greater risk that players will give up and no longer buy the next installment?

blocks.source: クリア後プレイヤーはさほど多くない
blocks.translation: Not Many Players Continue After Completion

blocks.source: クリア後のおまけ要素まで手を出すプレイヤーは、クリア者のさらに半分未満。
blocks.translation: Fewer than half of those who complete a game go on to play its bonus content.

blocks.source: トロフィーのコンプリートまでやるプレイヤーは、難易度にもよるが数％程度。
blocks.translation: Only a few percent of players go as far as completing all the trophies, depending on the difficulty.

blocks.source: どうしてもこういったヘビーユーザの声は目立ちますが、基本的には少数派と考えたほうがよさそうです。しっかりやり込む根強いファンも、それはそれで大事にしたいでしょうけれど。
blocks.translation: The voices of hardcore users like these inevitably stand out, but it would probably be better to consider them a minority overall. Of course, devoted fans who thoroughly immerse themselves in a game are important too.

blocks.source: 洋ゲ―ＲＰＧの時代は遠そう
blocks.translation: The Era of Western RPGs Still Seems Far Off

blocks.source: ウィッチャー３のクリア率も３０％と低め。追加ＤＬＣ（無情なる心）のクリア率に至っては全プレイヤーの１１％。
blocks.translation: The Witcher 3 also has a relatively low completion rate of 30%. The completion rate for the additional DLC (Hearts of Stone) is only 11% of all players.

blocks.source: 評判のいい作品でも、やはり敷居の高さはいかんともし難い模様。日本でこの種の洋ゲ―ＲＰＧが流行る日は遠そうです。
blocks.translation: Even well-regarded games seem unable to overcome their high barrier to entry. It looks like the day when this kind of Western RPG becomes popular in Japan is still a long way off.

blocks.source: 逆に言えば、ＦＦシリーズは海外で売上を維持できる可能性も……？
blocks.translation: Conversely, could the Final Fantasy series possibly maintain its sales overseas...?

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: みんな意外とＲＰＧをクリアせずに投げ出していたという驚愕の事実。
blocks.translation: The astonishing fact is that more people than you might expect give up on RPGs without completing them.

blocks.source: 色々と書きましたが、作品を評価する上で、クリア率は客観的な指標として使えるんじゃないでしょうか。
blocks.translation: I’ve written about various things, but completion rate might be usable as an objective indicator when evaluating a game.

blocks.source: 例えば、レビューサイトの評価だと、どうしてもクリアしたユーザの声が中心になります。
blocks.translation: For example, reviews on review sites inevitably center on the opinions of users who completed the game.

blocks.source: ですが、多くのゲームではプレイヤーの半数以上が未クリア――というのが現実なわけで、そっちの半分の実態を知ることも大事なんじゃないかなと。
blocks.translation: However, the reality is that in many games, more than half of the players never complete them—and I think it’s important to understand what that other half actually experiences as well.

blocks.source: ともあれ、最近のＲＰＧは相当敷居が高いんじゃないか――と、思わせるようなデータでした。
blocks.translation: In any case, these data made me think that modern RPGs may have a considerably high barrier to entry.

blocks.source: 全般的にプレイ時間が長くて初心者や社会人プレイヤーには厳しい。
blocks.translation: Playtimes are generally long, making them tough for beginners and working adults.

blocks.source: ＦＦ１３、１５は程々のプレイ時間だが、すっかり人を選ぶゲームに。
blocks.translation: FF13 and FF15 have moderate playtimes, but they’ve become games that strongly appeal only to certain people.

blocks.source: その他のゲームも色んな要素が盛り沢山で、疲れてしまうのかも。
blocks.translation: Other games are also packed with all kinds of elements, which may leave players feeling exhausted.

blocks.source: そう言えば、ＰＳ３以降で敷居の低いＲＰＧを見た記憶がほとんどありません。
blocks.translation: Come to think of it, I can hardly remember seeing an RPG with a low barrier to entry since the PS3 era.

blocks.source: 今時のＲＰＧ初心者はどうやって入ってるんでしょうかね？ やっぱり、携帯機のドラクエやポケモンになるんでしょうか。
blocks.translation: How do RPG beginners these days get into the genre, I wonder? I suppose they turn to handheld versions of Dragon Quest or Pokémon.

blocks.source: ドラクエのリメイクとかなら、遊びやすくて入りやすいでしょうけど。新作でライトユーザを取り込める作品がないとすれば、大いに問題だなと思います。
blocks.translation: Remakes of Dragon Quest would be easy and welcoming to play, but if there are no new games that can attract casual users, I think that’s a serious problem.

blocks.source: ドラクエやポケモンの売上が安定しているのは、ゲームデザインがシンプルかつプレイ時間が程々で、クリア率が高いから――とも考えられます。
blocks.translation: One possible reason Dragon Quest and Pokémon maintain steady sales is that their game design is simple, their playtimes are moderate, and their completion rates are high.

blocks.source: ……ドラクエ７みたいな例外もありますけれど。
blocks.translation: ...Though there are exceptions like Dragon Quest VII.

blocks.source: そんなわけで勝手ながらドラクエ１１には、売上的にも内容的にも大いに期待しておきます。
blocks.translation: So, if I may be presumptuous, I have very high expectations for Dragon Quest XI, both in terms of sales and content.

texts.皆さんはどれぐらいのプレイヤーがＲＰＧをクリアしているか、ご存じでしょうか？: Do you know what percentage of players complete RPGs?
texts.アマチュアＲＰＧ作家としては気になるところですが、今までは調べようがありませんで: This is something I’ve been curious about as an amateur RPG creator, but until now there was no way to find out. …Or so I thought—actually, there is a way to check, but only for commercially released games from the PS3 onward.
texts.どうするかといえば、トロフィー機能を参照するだけです。: All you have to do is check the trophy feature.
texts.※ＰＳ３以降を持ってない方のために説明すると、トロフィーというのは各ゲームで達成: ※For those who don’t own a PS3 or later, trophies are a feature that records achievements in each game. These include things like “defeated a certain boss,” “obtained a rare item,” and “completed a certain event.”
texts.ＰＳ４（Ｖｉｔａも？）ではネット接続しているプレイヤーを対象に、各トロフィー毎の: On the PS4 (and Vita, perhaps?), the completion rate for each trophy is displayed for players connected to the internet.
texts.大抵のゲームにはクリアによるトロフィーが存在しているので、クリア率も確認可能――: Since most games have a trophy for completing them, that means you can also check their completion rates.
texts.※細かいことを言うと、ＰＳ３には達成率の表示はありませんが、ＰＳ４からＰＳ３のゲ: ※Strictly speaking, the PS3 does not display completion rates, but you can check PS3 games from a PS4.
texts.そんなわけで興味本位を発揮して、自分が持っているタイトルを確認してみました。ＰＳ: So, driven by curiosity, I checked the titles I own. I haven’t played that many games from the PS3 onward, so the sample size is somewhat small.
texts.テイルズオブグレイセスｆ（＋追加編）: Tales of Graces f (+ Additional Chapter)
texts.英雄伝説 閃の軌跡: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel
texts.英雄伝説 閃の軌跡２（＋追加編）: The Legend of Heroes: Trails of Cold Steel II (+ Additional Chapter)
texts.2017/1/12調べ。ＦＦ１５は発売間もないので、まだ多少は上がるかも。: Checked on 2017/1/12. Final Fantasy XV had only recently been released, so its rate may still rise somewhat.
texts.クリア時間はあくまで筆者による参考値です。: The completion times are merely reference values based on the author’s experience.
texts.自分でクリアしてないものは？をつけています。: A question mark indicates games I did not complete myself.
texts.本編とは別に後日談的なものがある場合は（）で追記しています。: If there is an epilogue-like story separate from the main game, it is noted in parentheses.
texts.ＰＳ＋のフリープレイ対象である場合は、率が下がると考えられます。「無料なのでイン: Games included in PS Plus’s free game lineup can be expected to have lower rates, since some people install them because they’re free but stop playing soon afterward.
texts.この中では、閃の軌跡１～２やデモンズソウルがそれに該当。: Among these, Trails of Cold Steel I–II and Demon’s Souls fall into that category.
texts.さて、どうでしょうか？ 個人的には驚くほど低いですね。: So, what do you think? Personally, I find them surprisingly low.
texts.見る限り、プレイヤーの半分程度クリアしていればマシなほうです。: Judging by these figures, having about half of the players complete a game is actually relatively good.
texts.自分の場合、お金を出して買ったゲームの九割はクリアするようにしています。そのため: Personally, I make a point of completing nine out of every ten games I pay for. Because of that, I had assumed—quite arbitrarily—that around 80% of other players would complete a standard RPG as well.
texts.今の時代、ネット上で簡単に攻略が見れますので、クリアできないゲームというのはさほ: I also thought that, in this day and age, there shouldn’t be that many games people can’t complete, since walkthroughs are readily available online.
texts.それでもご覧の有様。: And yet, these are the results.
texts.またこれは、ゲーム機一台辺りに対する判定であることも注意してください。実際には、: Also keep in mind that these figures are measured per game console. In reality, the most common situation is probably a family sharing a single console.
texts.「兄ちゃんはクリアしたけど、弟は飽きてやめた」などのパターンであっても、トロフィ: Even in cases like “Big brother completed it, but little brother got bored and quit,” the trophy is still counted as achieved.
texts.一人当たりのクリア率は、もう少し低いと考えたほうがよいかもしれません。: It may be better to assume that the completion rate per person is somewhat lower.
texts.低すぎるＦＦ１３のクリア率: Final Fantasy XIII’s Far Too Low Completion Rate
texts.個別の例に言及すると、目に見えて低いＦＦ１３（27.7%）が際立ちます。: Looking at individual examples, the conspicuously low rate for Final Fantasy XIII (27.7%) stands out.
texts.クリアしたプレイヤーは全体の三割にも満たないのが現実。他のＲＰＧと比較して、半分: In reality, fewer than 30% of all players completed it. Compared with other RPGs, it would be fair to describe its completion rate as nearly half as high.
texts.ストーリー的な評判があまりよくないのは周知の通りですし、難易度も高めです。ただプ: As is well known, its story has a rather poor reputation, and the difficulty is also on the high side. However, since the playtime (40 hours in my case) isn’t particularly long, I don’t get the impression that it is exceptionally difficult to complete.
texts.なんだかんだで「手応えがあって面白い」と楽しんでいる声も聞こえたため、ここまでの: Despite everything, I heard some people saying they were enjoying it because it was "challenging and fun," so the reality turned out to be unexpected.
texts.そんなわけで、投げ出されやすい理由を考えてみます。: With that in mind, let me consider why people are so likely to give up on it.
texts.※後日、イージーモードが搭載されたようだが、時既に遅し。: ※An Easy Mode appears to have been added later, but by then it was too late.
texts.後半、自由度が急激に上がる。それ自体は長所とも言えるが、サブイベントをこなしてい: The degree of freedom rises sharply in the latter half. That can be considered a strength in itself, but some players may get bored while completing the side events.
texts.ゲーム進行によって成長の上限がある。: The growth cap depends on game progression.
texts.レベルを上げてのゴリ押しが難しい。: It is difficult to brute-force your way through by leveling up.
texts.敵がしぶとく、回復が容易でなかなか全滅しない。: The enemies are tenacious, and healing is easy, so it is difficult to wipe them out.
texts.結果、戦闘が長ったるく長時間戦ってからの全滅がプレイヤーの心を折る。: As a result, the long, drawn-out battles and being wiped out after fighting for a long time break the player's spirit.
texts.売上が多いためユーザ層が広い。相対的にライトユーザの比率が高い。: Because it sold so well, its user base is broad. Relatively speaking, it has a high proportion of casual users.
texts.こんなところでしょうか。: That about covers it, I suppose.
texts.特に３，４はこのゲーム特有の要素なので、影響が大きかったのではないかと思います。: In particular, points 3 and 4 are elements unique to this game, so I think they may have had a significant impact.
texts.察するに、ＦＦ１３という作品は想像以上に敷居が高く、マニアックなゲームになってい: It seems to me that FF XIII was more intimidating and had become more of a niche game than one might have imagined.
texts.事実、レビューサイトの点数分布が特徴的で、高得点から低得点へ満遍なく広がっていま: In fact, the distribution of scores on review sites is distinctive, spreading evenly from high scores to low scores. This is characteristic of games that appeal only to certain people.
texts.多くのユーザはゲームをクリアして批判するような段階にも至らず、『このゲームは難し: Many users probably never even reached the point of clearing the game and criticizing it; they simply left, saying things like, "This game is too difficult," "The atmosphere doesn't suit me," or "It's boring."
texts.さすがに「クリア困難なゲーム＝悪いゲーム」と決めつけるのは短絡的かと思います。デ: Surely, deciding that "a game that is difficult to clear equals a bad game" is overly simplistic. For a game aimed at hardcore users, like Demon's Souls, many fans would probably say it would not be fun otherwise.
texts.ただ、ミリオン級の大衆向けＲＰＧとしては致命的です。プレイヤーの七割が放り出すゲ: However, it is fatal for a mainstream RPG aimed at million-selling numbers. If a game is abandoned by seventy percent of its players, there is no way it can maintain sales of a million copies.
texts.特にＦＦのようなストーリーが重視される作品ではなおさらです。なんせ、最後までやら: This is especially true for works like FF, where the story is a major focus. After all, if you do not play to the end, it is difficult to say that you truly experienced it.
texts.そして、堪能できなかった作品の次回作を買う動機は薄いです。ＦＦ１３→ＦＦ１３－２: And there is little motivation to buy the next installment of a game you could not fully enjoy. With a story-connected sequel like FF XIII → FF XIII-2, the sequel becomes incomprehensible if you have not cleared the previous game.
texts.ＦＦ１３ ：初週１５１万 累計１９３万: FF XIII: 1.51 million in its first week, 1.93 million cumulative
texts.ＦＦ１５ ：初週６９万 累計１００万？（未確定）: FF XV: 690,000 in its first week, 1 million cumulative? (unconfirmed)
texts.※ＦＦ１４はネトゲで性質が違うため省きます。: ※FF XIV is omitted because it is an online game with different characteristics.
texts.こうしてみれば、ＦＦ１３－２およびＦＦ１５の売上激減も納得できようというものです: Seen in this light, the sharp drop in sales of FF XIII-2 and FF XV becomes understandable.
texts.一般的なＲＰＧの半分程度しかクリアされていないＦＦ１３の次回作。ゆえに、前作の半: FF XIII's sequel was based on a game that only about half as many people cleared as a typical RPG. Consequently, it sold only half as many copies as its predecessor. This may be a somewhat forceful interpretation, but it is one possible way of looking at it.
texts.というか、宣伝や話題性ではポケモンサンムーン（累計３００万超え）にも負けないレベ: Actually, although its advertising and buzz were on a level that could rival Pokémon Sun and Moon (over 3 million cumulative), the difference in sales is like night and day. As a former FF and Square Enix diehard, it makes me sad to think that users have truly lost interest in it.
texts.今のところ、ＦＦ１５のクリア率（38.2%）も厳しいところですね。ペルソナ５（4: For now, FF XV's clear rate (38.2%) is also concerning. Considering that it can be cleared in a fraction of the time required for Persona 5 (47.9%), it is still low.
texts.その他トロフィーを眺めて気づいた点: Other Observations from Looking at the Trophies
texts.クリア率が５０％程度あれば標準的。: A clear rate of around 50% is considered standard.
texts.プレイヤーの半分しかクリアしてないのでは、次回作で売上激減するんじゃ――と、心配: You might worry that if only half of the players cleared a game, sales of the next installment would plummet—but apparently, things are generally fine.
texts.それだけあれば、次回作も同等程度の売上が見込める模様。もちろん、内容と評判がまと: With that many players, the next installment can apparently be expected to achieve roughly comparable sales. Of course, this assumes that its content and reputation are sound.
texts.上の表で言えば、テイルズオブグレイセスｆの本編クリア率（63.8%）が優秀ですが: In the table above, Tales of Graces f has an excellent clear rate for its main story (63.8%), and this also seems to have translated into sales of the next installment.
texts.テイルズオブグレイセス：初週３６万本 累計５５万本（ＰＳ３＋Ｗｉｉ）: Tales of Graces: 360,000 copies in its first week, 550,000 cumulative (PS3 + Wii)
texts.テイルズオブエクシリア：初週５２万本 累計６７万本（ＰＳ３のみ）: Tales of Xillia: 520,000 copies in its first week, 670,000 cumulative (PS3 only)
texts.エクシリア以降で評判と売上を落としたのが、つくづくもったいないですね。この調子な: It is truly a shame that its reputation and sales declined after Xillia. At this rate, it might even have been within reach of FF XV's first-week sales (690,000)...
texts.こうなると「難易度が低くクリア時間も短いが、つまらないＲＰＧ」だとクリア率や次回: This makes me wonder what the clear rate and sales of the next installment would be for a "boring RPG with low difficulty and a short completion time," but I will not discuss it because there is no data.
texts.超序盤の脱落者: Players Who Drop Out Very Early
texts.開始一時間など、超序盤での脱落者が５～１０％程度どのゲームにも存在する。: Every game has about 5–10% of its players drop out very early, such as within the first hour.
texts.合わないと見て、速攻で中古に売り払っているとかでしょうか？: Perhaps they decide it is not for them and immediately sell it to a used-game store?
texts.脱落率はプレイ時間に比例: The Dropout Rate Is Proportional to Play Time
texts.多くのゲームでは、シナリオの区切りによってトロフィーを獲得できるようになっていま: In many games, trophies can be earned at scenario milestones. In other words, it is immediately obvious at what stage, and to what extent, players dropped out.
texts.当然、難所になるほど達成率が下がるはず。……そう考えていたのですが、思ったほど差: Naturally, the completion rate should fall as the difficulty increases. ...That is what I thought, but the difference was not as large as expected.
texts.例えば、ＦＦ１５の悪名高い十三章ですが、達成率の変化は47%→43%というように: For example, in the infamous Chapter 13 of FF XV, the change in completion rate was only about one-tenth at most, going from 47% to 43%.
texts.他の章と比較しても大差はありません。単純に時間のかかる章で、脱落者が多い傾向があ: There is no significant difference compared with the other chapters. It merely showed a tendency for more players to drop out in chapters that took a long time. In particular, many players dropped out when the degree of freedom increased, as in Chapter 3 (83% → 71%).
texts.プレイヤーの脱落は最初から最後までわりと満遍なく存在する。: Players drop out fairly evenly from start to finish.
texts.もう少し言うと、プレイ時間が伸びるごとに、脱落者が発生している。: To put it another way, players drop out with each additional hour of playtime.
texts.評価が良いゲームであっても、１時間伸びるごとに１％ぐらいは脱落。: Even for well-reviewed games, about 1% of players drop out with each additional hour.
texts.クリア率の表とどことなく一致しています。: This coincides, more or less, with the completion-rate table.
texts.しかも、これは良作として評価される作品、および敷居の低い作品の場合です。: What’s more, this applies to games considered good and games with a low barrier to entry.
texts.ＦＦ１３に至っては１時間ごとに３％前後脱落している計算になります。: In the case of FF13, the calculation comes to around 3% dropping out every hour.
texts.こうしてみると、プレイ時間稼ぎって本当に必要なのか疑問に感じます。: Looking at it this way, I wonder whether padding the playtime is really necessary.
texts.「プレイ時間を稼いで、中古に売られないようにしている」なんて俗説を聞きますが、本: I’ve heard the popular theory that games pad their playtime so players won’t sell them used, but if that’s true, it’s a dangerous way of thinking. Wouldn’t there be a greater risk that players will give up and no longer buy the next installment?
texts.クリア後プレイヤーはさほど多くない: Not Many Players Continue After Completion
texts.クリア後のおまけ要素まで手を出すプレイヤーは、クリア者のさらに半分未満。: Fewer than half of those who complete a game go on to play its bonus content.
texts.トロフィーのコンプリートまでやるプレイヤーは、難易度にもよるが数％程度。: Only a few percent of players go as far as completing all the trophies, depending on the difficulty.
texts.どうしてもこういったヘビーユーザの声は目立ちますが、基本的には少数派と考えたほう: The voices of hardcore users like these inevitably stand out, but it would probably be better to consider them a minority overall. Of course, devoted fans who thoroughly immerse themselves in a game are important too.
texts.洋ゲ―ＲＰＧの時代は遠そう: The Era of Western RPGs Still Seems Far Off
texts.ウィッチャー３のクリア率も３０％と低め。追加ＤＬＣ（無情なる心）のクリア率に至っ: The Witcher 3 also has a relatively low completion rate of 30%. The completion rate for the additional DLC (Hearts of Stone) is only 11% of all players.
texts.評判のいい作品でも、やはり敷居の高さはいかんともし難い模様。日本でこの種の洋ゲ―: Even well-regarded games seem unable to overcome their high barrier to entry. It looks like the day when this kind of Western RPG becomes popular in Japan is still a long way off.
texts.逆に言えば、ＦＦシリーズは海外で売上を維持できる可能性も……？: Conversely, could the Final Fantasy series possibly maintain its sales overseas...?

texts.色々と書きましたが、作品を評価する上で、クリア率は客観的な指標として使えるんじゃ: I’ve written about various things, but completion rate might be usable as an objective indicator when evaluating a game.
texts.例えば、レビューサイトの評価だと、どうしてもクリアしたユーザの声が中心になります: For example, reviews on review sites inevitably center on the opinions of users who completed the game.

texts.ともあれ、最近のＲＰＧは相当敷居が高いんじゃないか――と、思わせるようなデータで: In any case, these data made me think that modern RPGs may have a considerably high barrier to entry.
texts.全般的にプレイ時間が長くて初心者や社会人プレイヤーには厳しい。: Playtimes are generally long, making them tough for beginners and working adults.
texts.ＦＦ１３、１５は程々のプレイ時間だが、すっかり人を選ぶゲームに。: FF13 and FF15 have moderate playtimes, but they’ve become games that strongly appeal only to certain people.
texts.その他のゲームも色んな要素が盛り沢山で、疲れてしまうのかも。: Other games are also packed with all kinds of elements, which may leave players feeling exhausted.
texts.そう言えば、ＰＳ３以降で敷居の低いＲＰＧを見た記憶がほとんどありません。: Come to think of it, I can hardly remember seeing an RPG with a low barrier to entry since the PS3 era.
texts.今時のＲＰＧ初心者はどうやって入ってるんでしょうかね？ やっぱり、携帯機のドラク: How do RPG beginners these days get into the genre, I wonder? I suppose they turn to handheld versions of Dragon Quest or Pokémon.
texts.ドラクエのリメイクとかなら、遊びやすくて入りやすいでしょうけど。新作でライトユー: Remakes of Dragon Quest would be easy and welcoming to play, but if there are no new games that can attract casual users, I think that’s a serious problem.
texts.ドラクエやポケモンの売上が安定しているのは、ゲームデザインがシンプルかつプレイ時: One possible reason Dragon Quest and Pokémon maintain steady sales is that their game design is simple, their playtimes are moderate, and their completion rates are high.
texts.……ドラクエ７みたいな例外もありますけれど。: ...Though there are exceptions like Dragon Quest VII.
texts.そんなわけで勝手ながらドラクエ１１には、売上的にも内容的にも大いに期待しておきま: So, if I may be presumptuous, I have very high expectations for Dragon Quest XI, both in terms of sales and content.
